claims.claim_expires_when: Release after exact-head validation, merge, native Pages success, and proof that Site Task Runner no longer creates github-pages deployment records.
expected_evidence: Site Task Runner no longer declares environment github-pages
Site Task Runner no longer invokes configure-pages/upload-pages-artifact/deploy-pages
Site Task Runner public-route verification preserved
native Pages remains sole github-pages publication owner
collision_boundaries: Do not modify native GitHub Pages publisher
Do not add GitHub-token production authority
claims.next_task_after_release: Observe the next main Pages deployment and Site Task Runner run and confirm only the native Pages workflow updates the github-pages environment.
